blocs.texte:
Dear {prenom},

{rendezvous}, {quand}. The invitation for your calendar is attached to this email.
The appointment takes place by video call, from your phone or your computer, with nothing to install: {visio}
Unable to come? You can cancel here, and the time will go to another client: {annulation}

See you soon,
The Awrea Paris atelier
